description: This file defines the GatewayPushSubscription enum with static methods for consuming push notifications asynchronously and restarting the task that handles push notifications.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Asynchronously consumes GatewayPush notifications, passing each to the onPush callback, and respects task cancellation.

methods.name: restartTask
methods.description: Restarts a given async task to handle push notifications, cancelling the previous one if exists.
